summary: Fixed manual placement and deletion intent across rebuild/serialization, removed associated fence-run points, and corrected terrain-grading event coalescing so a local road edit no longer triggers unrelated forest rebuilding. Shelter glazing, seat and timetable now read clearly. Revised crown geometry, impostors, bark, hedge surfaces and diagnostic crops, but the final visual result remains below target and introduces an aerial props triangle-budget miss. Completed and personally inspected all34 required shots plus a1080p forest22 baseline and21 auxiliary images. This is a candid partial round, not an8.5 pass.

implementation: Persistent manual ledger with stable high-range IDs; coordinate/kind deletion tombstones prevent rules from recreating removed placements, including another fence variant at the same location. Explicit manual placement bypasses rule tombstones while retaining ordinary placement validation unless force is supplied.
Remove splits generated fence/hedge runs at deleted points and deletes owned manual runs, associated render records and relevant lamp data; dirty chunks rebuilt together.
Preserve named road-edit payload while roads is flattening terrain; avoid redundant roads rebuild; cache pool heights between local edits.
Bowed leaf cluster geometry with varied normals and fewer crossed cards, irregular bark phase, revised lit impostor shapes; automatic top-down uses LOD1 to avoid horizontal caps.
Merged shelter glass with opacity.18, depthWritefalse and no shadow; front view reveals seat and timetable. Hedge width/top vary, still insufficiently volumetric.
Compute visible trunk crop separately from offscreen crown; project actual camera-right trunk width; retain only fully in-frame pool boundaries; independent head crop.

visualInspectionNotes.standard16: All16 individually viewed at full image size. Golden-hour shadows and night pools are readable; aerial and skyline foliage remain synthetic. No loading overlay, water confetti or console failures observed.
visualInspectionNotes.forest: Forest12/17.5/22 show distinct orange, pale broadleaf and blue conifer classes near camera, but obvious layered flat conifer templates farther away and excessive fine gaps.
visualInspectionNotes.avenue: Both verges, seated furniture, mast signals and warm night pools read; foliage fans and slab hedges remain apparent at1080 and720.
visualInspectionNotes.signal: Modeled three-lens housings, visors and collars; stub changes visible lenses. Exact lens clipping not measured for every head.
visualInspectionNotes.lamp: Complete head and pool now fit20.5m view. Head remains clipped; pool rectangle still too broad for material isolation.
visualInspectionNotes.park: Benches, bins, planters, ornamental lanterns and two fence types form an organized plaza. Hedge crop missing and green wall silhouette weak.
visualInspectionNotes.treecloseup: Trunk and branch whorls plainly visible, revised bark still low contrast; large leaf fans persist.
visualInspectionNotes.busstop: Glazing is see-through; seat and timetable clearly visible day/night.
visualInspectionNotes.canopy: No circular caps or flat horizontal impostor cards; sparse fragmented crowns and irregular shrub/fence edges remain.
visualInspectionNotes.integration: Empty city with UI, terrain and water; all modules ready. No populated-city performance inference.
visualInspectionNotes.auxiliary21: Personally viewed all seven on/off pairs, dolly pair, wind pair, zero-wind pair and traffic-stub frame. Used for reproducible approximate masks and raw diffs, with residual measurement limitations.

limitations: Manual fence trisBefore/After API count is unchanged because that test fence is outside the forest view; run metadata15→14 and item deletion are verified, not a claimed pixel-area reduction.

The initially denied replacement in deletion probe was blocked by normal collision rules after regeneration. Final replacement test intentionally supplies force:true to verify tombstone override, then removes it; this is not evidence of general overlap acceptance.
The final tombstone fix only changes nonempty deletion/edit state. Main showcase captures have no deletion intents and remain representative of final baseline rendering.
System python lacked Pillow; metrics ran successfully with bundled Python. No source outside props, no assets fetched, no commits/pushes, no server restart.
